company.name: Gumloop
company.shortDescription: Gumloop is a no-code platform that allows non-technical teams to build and host their own AI-powered business automations.
company.description:
Gumloop provides a software platform that enables users to build automated workflows using artificial intelligence and connected applications. The platform includes a visual builder where users arrange modular components to create workflows that process data, generate content, analyze information, and trigger actions across integrated tools. It connects with business applications such as email services, customer relationship management systems, messaging platforms, spreadsheets, and databases to move and transform information between systems.

Gumloop supports tasks such as document summarization, lead analysis, report generation, and automated messaging through workflows that run on schedules or events. The system also allows AI models to interpret inputs, categorize data, and determine workflow steps within a process. The platform includes templates, integrations, and interfaces that allow teams to design, run, and manage automation processes without writing code.
